results.text: Which sellers have never had a dispute raised against their orders?
results.category: right values but WRONG ROW COUNT (missing aggregation/filter)

SELECT s.seller_id, s.display_name
FROM sellers s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.seller_id = o.seller_id

LIMIT 1000;
